articles.headline: Supreme Court voids Yes Bank's $880 million AT-1 write-off
articles.brief: In a major relief for investors, India's top court has officially voided Yes Bank's $880 million AT-1 bond write-off, reversing previous financial decisions and setting a critical precedent for bondholders and banking sector regulations across the country.

articles.headline: RBI spends half of FX capital haul defending rupee
articles.brief: Banking estimates reveal that the Reserve Bank of India has utilized roughly half of its $140 billion foreign exchange capital haul toward defending the domestic currency against heavy global market pressures.

articles.headline: India-China trade jumps 29% to bypass US
articles.brief: Bilateral trade between India and China surged by 29% to reach $91.76 billion during the first half of fiscal year 2027, successfully overtaking the United States as India's leading trade partner in the period.
articles.dateLocation: October 15, 2026 | New Delhi / Times of India

articles.headline: Income Tax tribunal orders ₹13,000-crore tax relief to Maruti
articles.brief: The Income Tax appellate tribunal has granted a massive relief of ₹13,000 crore to automotive giant Maruti Suzuki, resolving long-standing tax disputes and boosting investor confidence in the sector.

articles.headline: Government mandates caller ID display starting November 1
articles.brief: The Department of Telecommunications is rolling out the Calling Name Presentation feature, making caller ID displays mandatory across 4G networks starting November 1 to improve user identification and combat spam.
articles.dateLocation: October 15, 2026 | New Delhi / Times of India

articles.headline: Anthropic infuses spiritual framing into frontier AI models
articles.brief: Tech major Anthropic is introducing philosophical and spiritual concepts into the training paradigms of its frontier AI models, sparking intensive industry debate about machine consciousness and governance frameworks.
articles.dateLocation: October 15, 2026 | San Francisco / Times of India

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi urges President to reconsider gubernatorial appointment
articles.brief: Senior political leader Rahul Gandhi has petitioned the President of India to reconsider a controversial gubernatorial appointment citing pending Central Bureau of Investigation probes and constitutional immunity concerns.

articles.headline: Prashant Bhushan calls for regime change amid protests
articles.brief: Noted activist and lawyer Prashant Bhushan openly advocated for electoral regime change during aggressive anti-Commission protests, drawing sharp counterattacks from ruling party officials.
articles.dateLocation: October 15, 2026 | New Delhi / Times of India

articles.headline: Trump weighs massive military strike on Iranian nuclear sites
articles.brief: Former US President Donald Trump is reportedly weighing heavy military options, including potential strikes utilizing bunker-buster munitions, against Iranian nuclear and energy infrastructure facilities.

articles.headline: Turkey-Azerbaijan strategic alliance strained over hijab row
articles.brief: A burgeoning domestic hijab row and divergent geopolitical alignments, including regional ties with Israel, have unexpectedly strained the long-standing strategic partnership between Turkey and Azerbaijan.

articles.headline: South Africa drops Tristan Stubbs after crushing Test defeat
articles.brief: Following a heavy defeat in Durban, South Africa's cricket selectors have dropped batsman Tristan Stubbs from the Test squad, calling up alternative talent and targeting an urgent return for spearhead Kagiso Rabada.

articles.headline: Shai Hope praised for anchoring West Indies in series
articles.brief: Cricketing analysts have lauded West Indies batsman Shai Hope for bucking modern trends by anchoring low-risk innings, effectively marshalling his side through difficult chases against India.

articles.headline: Maharashtra FDA suspends hundreds of licenses over adulterated food
articles.brief: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration suspended nearly 900 food business licenses and seized ₹50 crore worth of adulterated food products following sweeping statewide inspections over a six-month period.

articles.headline: Nestle India reports profit surge amid commodity inflation
articles.brief: Nestle India registered a strong 36% surge in quarterly profit, though executives quickly cautioned shareholders regarding persistent food and global commodity price inflation moving forward.

articles.headline: India's August balance of payments swings to surplus
articles.brief: Official figures show that India's balance of payments swung to a healthy surplus of $45.4 billion in August, bolstered by strong capital inflows and stabilizing foreign exchange reserves.

articles.headline: Indian bank deposits hit record $3 trillion in September
articles.brief: Driven heavily by aggressive dollar deposit schemes and robust domestic savings growth, total Indian bank deposits crossed a historic milestone of $3 trillion in September.
